name: Sorting by price Low→High reorders cards correctly

steps.description: Click the sort dropdown to open it
steps.snapshotHint: The sort control is a native HTML <select> element (not a p-select). Look for a <select> on the catalog page with options like 'Most popular', 'Newest', 'Price: low to high', 'Price: high to low'

steps.description: Select 'Price: Low to High' sort option
steps.snapshotHint: Look for option text containing 'Low' and 'High' or price arrow up

steps.script: (() => { const prices = [...document.querySelectorAll('.price-amount')].map(e => parseFloat(e.textContent.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0); const sorted = [...prices].sort((a, b) => a - b); return { prices: prices.slice(0, 5), isSorted: JSON.stringify(prices.slice(0, 10)) === JSON.stringify(sorted.slice(0, 10)) }; })()
steps.description: Prices should be in ascending order after sort

businessContext: Price sorting is the second most used catalog feature after search
